== tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  doc "generated core bench 4"

inst 000001 core:isource
  at 0 0 R90
  name I0
  value 1m
inst 000005 core:cap
  at 200 0 MR180
  name C1
  value 2p
  m 2
inst 000010 core:nmos4
  at 400 0 MR180
  name M2
  model nch
  l 0.5u

wire 000003 -30 0 0 -10
wire 000006 200 30 230 20
wire 000008 200 -30 230 -40

label 000002 30 0 R0 0
label 000004 0 -10 R0 c
label 000007 230 20 R0 0
label 000009 230 -40 R0 b
label 000011 420 30 R0 c
label 000012 380 0 R0 b
label 000013 420 -30 R0 b

  | .op
